note: Still Waiting case list, carried forward weekly. Verify each case every Sunday against sources that name the person and state each fact. Choose cases by severity and need for attention, not to balance India against World: include Indian cases that matter, and keep the world in view, since cases elsewhere are equally important.

cases.name: Umar Khalid
cases.status: Supreme Court bail plea filed 5 Nov against Delhi HC's 30 Sep refusal, its third; not yet heard. Trial not begun. Delhi Police call his fresh bail pleas premature under the Supreme Court's one-year bar

cases.name: Sharjeel Imam
cases.status: Supreme Court bail plea filed 5 Nov says no prosecution witness examined yet; not yet heard. On 14 Nov India's US ambassador said USCIRF, which says he is held for religious-freedom advocacy, has 'no locus standi'

cases.name: Srishti Gupta
cases.status: Artist still jailed; Scroll reported no bail in 2 of her 11 cases (22 Sep). A police chargesheet calls her a 'key conspirator'. No new developments reported 8–15 Nov

cases.name: Satyam Verma
cases.law: NSA (order 12 May 2026) plus Noida protest FIRs
cases.status: Journalist held under NSA despite bail in one case (15 Sep). Allahabad HC reserved its verdict on his NSA challenge on 8 Oct; no judgment reported by 15 Nov. UP Police allege a major role in protest violence

cases.name: Dawit Isaak
cases.status: Journalist held incommunicado 25 years without charge or trial; whereabouts and health unknown. Eritrea's president said in 2009 there would be no trial and no release. No new developments reported 8–15 Nov

cases.name: Abdulhadi Al-Khawaja
cases.status: Rights defender, 65, serving life in Jau Prison; family reports heart problems and glaucoma. 31 groups urged France's president in October to press for his release. No Bahraini government response reported

cases.name: Osman Kavala
cases.status: An Istanbul appeals court again refused his release and retrial (reported 14 Nov), despite a binding European Court of Human Rights ruling. Government denies the case is political and says courts are independent

cases.name: Jimmy Lai
cases.status: Serving 20 years, aged 78. Trump said this week Xi has not agreed to free him, citing Beijing's 'hatred' for Lai. Hong Kong says he was not tried for his political views

cases.name: Aung San Suu Kyi
cases.law: Coup-era convictions; term cut to about 18 years (AP)
cases.status: Under house arrest in Naypyitaw since April; her son reported his first phone call with her in five years on 22 Oct. Government rejects calls for her release. No new developments reported 8–15 Nov

cases.name: Imran Aliyev
cases.law: Smuggling, money laundering, tax evasion, illegal entrepreneurship, forgery (10 years)
cases.status: Meclis.info founder sentenced to 10 years by Baku Grave Crimes Court on 12 Nov; his lawyer says no credible evidence was presented and will appeal. Authorities deny prosecutions are political

cases.name: Dr Hussam Abu Safiya
cases.law: Unlawful Combatants Law; no charge, no trial
cases.status: Hospital director held without charge. Israeli courts refused to free 14 detained doctors and denied him an independent medical exam (reported 11 Nov). Israel alleges Hamas links, which his family denies

cases.name: Detainees held by the RSF
cases.countcap: held in El Geneina, doctors say
cases.status: Doctors report food shortages and rising deaths in El Geneina; Amnesty documents torture, forced labour and ransom in El Fasher. RSF reportedly seized a defector's family in South Darfur (13 Nov). RSF has not responded

cases.name: Najmeh Amini
cases.law: Death sentence for blasphemy; 12.5 years on security charges
cases.status: 23-year-old student on death row in Mashhad's Vakilabad Prison over social media posts; her appeal is pending at the Supreme Court (HRANA, 10 Nov). No official statement reported
src: Center for Human Rights in Iran

cases.name: Imaan Mazari-Hazir and Hadi Ali Chattha
cases.law: Anti-Terrorism Act; earlier 17 years under electronic crimes law (PECA)
cases.status: Rights lawyers jailed since 23 Jan. Supreme Court suspended their PECA terms (17 Sep), but a 10-year anti-terror sentence followed a trial inside Adiala prison; appeal reported 7 Nov. Law minister says judiciary is independent

cases.name: Artin Ghazanfari
cases.law: 26 years incl. 'media activities' under espionage-penalties law
cases.status: Baha'i photojournalist with heart failure; judge reportedly refused the hospital transfer prison doctors advised. Sentence told to him on 26 Oct. Iran did not respond to CPJ. No new developments reported 8–15 Nov

cases.name: Mountaga Tall
cases.status: Lawyer and junta critic abducted in Bamako; his son also vanished on 16 May. Amnesty renewed calls (4 Nov) for proof they are alive. Authorities have not acknowledged holding either

cases.name: Zied el-Heni
cases.law: Telecommunications Code art. 86 (1 year); four terrorism-related charges (4 years)
cases.status: Journalist sentenced to four more years on 27 Oct over a leaked-audio report; 17 groups urged his release on 5 Nov. No official response or new developments reported 8–15 Nov

cases.name: Idris Khattak
cases.law: Official Secrets Act; 14 years by military court (2021)
cases.status: Rights defender seized near Swabi; military admitted holding him in June 2020. Rights groups (13 Nov) say his diabetes goes untreated and his life is at risk. Military says he passed information to foreign intelligence

cases.name: Joshua Wong
cases.law: National security law: conspiracy to collude with foreign forces (10 years)
cases.status: Democracy activist, jailed since 2020, given 10 more years on 5 Nov, keeping him in prison until 2036. Chief Executive John Lee welcomed the sentence; ten governments criticised it
